## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`; CONTRIBUTING.md, "Sign your work")
- [ ] `npm run type-check` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] For a visual change: a screenshot before and after
- [ ] The README or `docs/` updated where behaviour changed, and an entry under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md for a change a user notices

## Notes for reviewers

What to look at first, decisions you would like a second opinion on, or what is left for a follow-up.
